primitives.name: color/ink/600
primitives.description: Dark control boundary. 3.29:1 on ink-950, clears the 3:1 floor for a form control edge.

primitives.name: color/ink/900
primitives.description: One step off the darkest ground.

primitives.name: color/green/50
primitives.description: Light success surface. green-800 text sits on it at 5.10:1.

primitives.name: color/green/300
primitives.description: Lifted green, for hover on dark.

primitives.name: color/green/500
primitives.description: The signal green. Ink sits on it at 12.28:1 in both modes.

primitives.name: color/green/600
primitives.description: Light hover on a sample fill. Ink on it at 8.93:1, where green-700 was used for both hover and pressed.

primitives.name: color/green/800
primitives.description: Green that survives as text on paper. 5.24:1.

primitives.name: color/green/900
primitives.description: Dark success surface. green-500 text sits on it at 9.62:1.

primitives.name: color/red/50
primitives.description: Light danger surface. red-700 text sits on it at 5.54:1.

primitives.name: color/red/800
primitives.description: Hover on a danger fill. Paper on it at 7.54:1.

primitives.name: color/red/900
primitives.description: Dark danger surface. red-400 text sits on it at 4.60:1.

primitives.name: color/amber/50
primitives.description: Light warning surface. amber-700 text sits on it at 4.83:1.

primitives.name: color/amber/900
primitives.description: Dark warning surface. amber-500 text sits on it at 6.78:1.

primitives.name: color/blue/50
primitives.description: Light info surface. blue-700 text sits on it at 5.62:1.

primitives.name: color/blue/900
primitives.description: Dark info surface. blue-400 text sits on it at 6.61:1.

primitives.name: color/scrim/40
primitives.description: Ink-950 at 40%. Dims a light page without turning it grey.

primitives.name: color/scrim/72
primitives.description: Ink-950 at 72%. A dark page needs more to read as recessed.

semantic.name: color/canvas
semantic.description: The page ground.

semantic.name: color/surface
semantic.description: A raised surface: panels, menus, table headers. One step away from the canvas in both modes.

semantic.name: color/ink
semantic.description: Primary text. The name is the role, not the colour: it resolves to paper on a dark canvas.

semantic.name: color/muted
semantic.description: Secondary text. Clears AA in both modes.

semantic.name: color/faint
semantic.description: Tertiary text and placeholders. Clears AA in both modes, which the old dark value did not.

semantic.name: color/line
semantic.description: The default rule. Decorative, so it sits below the 3:1 floor on purpose.

semantic.name: color/line-strong
semantic.description: An emphasised rule. Still decorative.

semantic.name: color/line-interactive
semantic.description: The boundary of a form control. Clears 3:1 in both modes, which WCAG 1.4.11 requires and a decorative rule does not.

semantic.name: color/sample
semantic.description: Signal green as text, links and borders. Darkens in light mode so it stays readable on paper.

semantic.name: color/sample-fill
semantic.description: Signal green as a surface: buttons, the specimen dot. The same green in both modes, always with on-sample text over it.

semantic.name: color/sample-hover
semantic.description: Hover on a sample fill. Lifted in dark, deepened in light. Ink stays readable on both.

semantic.name: color/sample-pressed
semantic.description: Pressed state on a sample fill. Was green-800 in light, where ink on it fell to 3.38:1.

semantic.name: color/on-sample
semantic.description: Text and icons sitting on sample-fill. Ink in both modes: 12.28:1 either way.

semantic.name: color/danger
semantic.description: Error text and borders. Clears AA in both modes, which the old dark value did not.

semantic.name: color/warn
semantic.description: Warning text and borders.

semantic.name: color/success
semantic.description: Success text and borders. Success is the brand green doing its job as a status: the specimen is alive.

semantic.name: color/info
semantic.description: Informational text and borders. The only hue that is not brand or status-red/amber.

semantic.name: color/danger-subtle
semantic.description: Low-emphasis danger surface for inline alerts, invalid rows and toasts. Always with danger text over it.

semantic.name: color/warn-subtle
semantic.description: Low-emphasis warning surface. Always with warn text over it.

semantic.name: color/success-subtle
semantic.description: Low-emphasis success surface. Always with success text over it.

semantic.name: color/info-subtle
semantic.description: Low-emphasis info surface. Always with info text over it.

semantic.name: color/danger-fill
semantic.description: Destructive action as a surface: the confirm button in a delete dialog. Same red in both modes, always with on-danger text.

semantic.name: color/danger-hover
semantic.description: Hover and pressed on a danger fill.

semantic.name: color/on-danger
semantic.description: Text and icons sitting on danger-fill. Paper in both modes: 5.92:1.

semantic.name: color/disabled
semantic.description: Text and border of a disabled control. Around 3.3:1 in both modes: legible, clearly inert, and exempt from the AA text floor. Replaces opacity.

semantic.name: color/scrim
semantic.description: The layer behind an open Dialog. Separates by dimming, not by shadow: the system stays flat (brand §06) and the overlay itself carries surface and line-strong.

semantic.name: spacing/none
semantic.description: Collapse a gap or padding without leaving the scale. Dense table rows and flush-joined controls.

semantic.name: spacing/2xs
semantic.description: Icon to label inside a control, and the optical nudges that used to be written as mt-[2px].

semantic.name: spacing/xs
semantic.description: Tightest real gap. Chip internals, inline meta.

semantic.name: spacing/sm
semantic.description: Dense table cell padding, gap between adjacent controls.

semantic.name: spacing/md
semantic.description: Default gap between related elements.

semantic.name: spacing/lg
semantic.description: Default padding inside a control or cell.

semantic.name: spacing/xl
semantic.description: Comfortable control padding.

semantic.name: spacing/2xl
semantic.description: Card and panel padding.

semantic.name: spacing/3xl
semantic.description: Gap between groups within a panel.

semantic.name: spacing/4xl
semantic.description: Gap between panels.

semantic.name: spacing/5xl
semantic.description: Section padding inside a page.

semantic.name: spacing/6xl
semantic.description: Gap between page sections.

semantic.name: spacing/7xl
semantic.description: Page gutter on wide viewports.

semantic.name: spacing/8xl
semantic.description: Empty states and full-page notices.

semantic.name: spacing/9xl
semantic.description: Marketing sections and the space above a page title on a landing view.

semantic.name: border/none
semantic.description: Remove an edge in a variant without dropping off the scale.

semantic.name: border/hairline
semantic.description: Every rule, panel edge, table row and input outline. The default.

semantic.name: border/strong
semantic.description: Emphasis. A selected table row, an active tab, the open item in a list.

semantic.name: border/focus
semantic.description: The focus ring, drawn as an outline with a 2px offset. Same weight as strong, kept separate so changing the ring never moves the selection state.

semantic.name: border/accent
semantic.description: A leading edge that carries meaning: the left bar on an alert or callout, keyed to a status colour.

semantic.name: radius/none
semantic.description: Square. Rules, table cells, tabs, anything that is structure rather than an object.

semantic.name: radius/sm
semantic.description: Controls: buttons, fields, selects, checkboxes, tags, menu items, tooltips. The mark's own corner.

semantic.name: radius/md
semantic.description: Panels that float or frame: dialogs, popovers, menus, toasts, the command menu, preview frames.

semantic.name: radius/full
semantic.description: The dot family: the specimen dot, radios, the switch track and its thumb.

semantic.name: text/micro
semantic.description: The tag. Uppercase, wide tracking.

semantic.name: text/label
semantic.description: Field labels, meta rows. Most common size in the codebase.

semantic.name: text/caption
semantic.description: Secondary copy, table cells.

semantic.name: text/body
semantic.description: Default reading size.

semantic.name: text/body-lg
semantic.description: Lead paragraph.

semantic.name: text/heading
semantic.description: Section heading.

semantic.name: text/display
semantic.description: Page display. One per view.

semantic.name: font/mono
semantic.description: IBM Plex Mono. The default voice of the system.

semantic.name: font/text
semantic.description: Archivo Variable. Used sparingly for display.

semantic.name: tracking/label
semantic.description: Uppercase labels. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

semantic.name: tracking/tag
semantic.description: The tag component. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

semantic.name: tracking/display
semantic.description: Tightened display type. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

semantic.name: tracking/wordmark
semantic.description: The wordmark only. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

semantic.name: leading/tight
semantic.description: Headings and display type.

semantic.name: leading/normal
semantic.description: Interface copy.

semantic.name: leading/relaxed
semantic.description: Reading paragraphs.

semantic.name: leading/loose
semantic.description: Long-form body, docs pages.

semantic.name: duration/fast
semantic.description: Colour and opacity transitions.

semantic.name: duration/blink
semantic.description: The cursor blink in .spc-cursor. step-end, infinite.

semantic.name: duration/pulse
semantic.description: The pulse in .spc-pulse. ease-in-out, infinite.

semantic.name: ease/spc
semantic.description: Motion: slow, small, seldom.

semantic.name: breakpoint/sm
semantic.description: Large phone and up. 14 uses in the codebase.

semantic.name: breakpoint/md
semantic.description: Tablet portrait and up.

semantic.name: breakpoint/lg
semantic.description: Tablet landscape and small laptop. 4 uses.

semantic.name: breakpoint/xl
semantic.description: Desktop. 1 use.

semantic.name: breakpoint/2xl
semantic.description: Wide desktop.

semantic.name: measure/sm
semantic.description: Short body copy, notices.

semantic.name: measure/md
semantic.description: Lead paragraphs.

semantic.name: measure/lg
semantic.description: Panels and setup notices.
